answer: Here is one mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. Today's words line up with the mechanism: marble mirrors the slashing that punishes duplicate work, vine maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, and violet captures the transparency that makes every pattern visible. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
